list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Six Ho ions form an octahedron. A μ2-fluoride bridges each of its twelve edges, a μ6-fluoride occupies its center, and each Ho ion is capped by one 12-crown-4 ligand. Two additional fluoride ions and three iodide ions are counterions.

synthesis.procedure: HoI3 and 12-crown-4 were stirred in acetonitrile at a 1:2 ratio for 10 minutes at room temperature. One equivalent of AgBF4 was added, and stirring continued for another 10 minutes. After centrifugation, the supernatant was allowed to evaporate at room temperature for a few hours.

reagents.name: Holmium(III) iodide

reagents.amount: 2 parts in a HoI3:12-crown-4 ratio of 1:2
reagents.name: 12-crown-4

synthesis.time: 10 minutes before AgBF4 addition; 10 minutes afterward; a few hours of evaporation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Centrifugation followed by evaporation of the supernatant yielded yellow block crystals.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A single Ho ion is coordinated by eight oxygen atoms from two 12-crown-4 ligands and the nitrogen atom of one acetonitrile molecule, giving a sandwich-type complex with three tetrafluoroborate counterions.

synthesis.procedure: In the HoI3/12-crown-4/acetonitrile reaction used for 1, increasing AgBF4 to two or three equivalents gave complex 2 instead. The article also reports obtaining 2 by adding another equivalent of AgBF4 to the solution in which 1 had formed.

reagents.amount: 2 parts per 1 part HoI3 in the initial reaction

reagents.amount: 2 or 3 equivalents in the initial reaction; alternatively, 1 further equivalent added to the solution of 1
reagents.name: Silver tetrafluoroborate

synthesis.temperature: Room temperature for the initial reaction
synthesis.vessel_or_method: AgBF4-dependent variation of the synthesis of 1
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: A colorless product was obtained; compound-specific isolation details are not stated in the main text.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The erbium analogue has an octahedral Er6 core with a μ2-fluoride across each edge and a six-coordinate μ6-fluoride at its center. Each Er ion is coordinated by a 12-crown-4 ligand; iodide and additional fluoride ions balance the cationic cluster.

synthesis.procedure: ErI3 replaced HoI3 under experimental conditions described as similar to those for 1. The article reports a room-temperature, one-pot reaction of LnI3, 12-crown-4 and AgBF4 in a 1:2:1 ratio in acetonitrile for the two cluster analogues.
